description.html: Maple leaf stone is a decorative stone in warm orange, reddish and brown tones. The pieces are irregular in shape with a rugged surface, so each one differs in shape and color. It is very popular in aquascaping, where several pieces are stacked into rock formations that imitate mountain cliffs or riverbanks.

The 1kg pack works well for a small accent or to supplement existing rocks; for larger compositions, plan for several packs. Combined with low plants and moss, the stone becomes the centerpiece of a striking aquascape. It is also used in terrariums, where its warm color complements desert substrates and the pieces give reptiles a foothold and a place to climb.

Before use, scrub the stone well under running water to remove dust and small debris. As with any decorative stone, before adding it to an aquarium with sensitive fish or shrimp we recommend checking whether it affects water hardness by testing the water after a few days in a container. Place larger pieces directly on the bottom before adding substrate so the composition does not collapse when fish or reptiles dig.
